scope: Factory exterior solid and two-tone paint tables for full size K or V Blazer and compact S-10 or S/T Blazer variants. Variant programs remain separate. A color in one variant is not projected onto another variant or an unsupported model year.

row_contract.color_legend: Exact source labels keyed by the source paint code. Labels remain scoped to the variant and model year in which they appear.
row_contract.solid_rows: Paint codes that appear as regular solid paint rows in the cited table.
row_contract.two_tone_rows: Ordered [color_code_1, color_code_2] pairs. The order is the paint application order printed by GM and is not interchangeable.
row_contract.stripe_rows: Where present, ordered [color_code_1, color_code_2, source stripe label] rows transcribed from the cited special program table.
row_contract.source_pages: One based PDF page numbers. Printed page locators and revision dates are retained beside each table.
row_contract.duplicate_editions: A later order guide table is kept as a separate edition when the retained kit also contains an earlier table. No union is inferred across editions.

method: Used the retained GM Heritage Vehicle Information Kit PDFs as the availability authority.
Matched every cited PDF to the committed SHA-256 and byte length in data/research/gm-official-color-tables/source_documents.parquet.
Rendered and visually reviewed every cited table page. Automated OCR candidates were used only as a finding aid.
Separated full size K or V Blazer programs from compact S-10 or S/T Blazer programs.
Did not infer a missing variant, model year, paint code, restriction, or two-tone pair from an adjacent year.

coverage_summary.unsupported_projection_rule: A year is not complete for the Blazer nameplate unless both full size and compact variants have verified evidence, when both variants existed. Missing evidence remains missing.

row_count_summary.counting_rule: Counts are the normalized exterior paint records in this audit. A solid row, an ordered two-tone pair, or an ordered stripe row each counts once. Duplicate source rows that differ only by interior recommendation are one exterior paint record. Distinct stripe choices for the same ordered color pair remain distinct stripe rows.
